name: A Sailor’s Life for Me
body:
The Keeper of the Seas has blessed you with the skills necessary to be a successful sailor.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a god of sailors

Benefit: You receive a +2 divine bonus to any two of the following skills: Craft (Sails), Craft (Rope), Knowledge (Nature), Perception, Profession (Sailor) or Profession (Shipwright).
